build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template with parameterized target position, radius, buffer, and angle values
create_static_bar_scene: create static bar obstacles including a floor, blocker, ramp, launch pad, and shield elements
add_dynamic_ball: add a dynamic ball to the scene with configurable scale, center_x, and center_y coordinates
update_task_relationship: update the task goal to require body1 touching body2 using SpatialRelationship.TOUCHING
set_solution_tier: set the task metadata to SolutionTier.BALL for ball-based puzzle categorization
